  Readable gloss: "A noun likely derived by reduplication from the root qrr or qur, qarqa' denotes the floor or ground-level surface of a structure. Amos 9:3 extends the image dramatically to the 'floor of the sea' -- the ocean bottom where fugitives might hide from God. German 'Boden' and French 'plancher' both capture the sense of a horizontal base surface."

French 'plancher,' German 'Boden,' and English 'floor' all reflect the same concrete image ...
